name: gate-pay-x402
description: Gate Pay protected-HTTP payment skill for the local gatepay-local-mcp server. Handles merchant request probing, x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED flows, MPP WWW-Authenticate sessions on Base, Gate Pay centralized payment, and wallet setup for quick_wallet, plugin_wallet, and local_private_key. Use when the user provides or needs to discover a paid HTTP resource, asks to pay an HTTP 402 or MPP endpoint, configure a Gate Pay local wallet, or complete the protected resource request after payment. Route to gate-exchange-pay instead when the user explicitly chooses Gate Exchange/Gate account balance and an upstream flow already has the structured merchant charge inputs; do not use this skill for generic exchange trading, deposits, withdrawals, or unrelated transfers.
